relationships.evidence_quote: To summarize the relevant targets of PD in various oxidative stress-related diseases through the activation of Silence information regulator1 (SIRT1).

relationships.subject: polydatin
relationships.evidence_quote: PD has been found to have significantly protective and curative effects on diseases associated with oxidative stress by regulating SIRT1-related targets

key_findings: Review: polydatin counters oxidative stress via SIRT1 targets including PGC-1alpha, Nrf2, HMGB1, NLRP3
